info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Financial Market Research API
info.description: The Financial Market Research API provides users with access to comprehensive market data, enabling insightful analysis of financial trends. This API allows consumers to retrieve valuable insights into various banking market indicators and research metrics. It serves as an essential tool for analysts, investors, and financial institutions seeking to inform their strategic decisions. By providing easy access to critical financial market information, this API supports informed investment strategies and market research activities.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific financial market research resource identified by its unique ID. Use this information to enhance your market analysis and decision-making processes.

requestBody.description: Request body to retrieve financial market research data pertaining to the specified resource. Ensure the request adheres to the defined schema for proper data retrieval.

200.description: Successfully retrieved financial market research data.

GetFinancialMarketResearchByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation in the financial market research API. It is intended to provide input data required for retrieving market data.

instrumentId.description: The unique identifier for the financial instrument.

isin.description: The International Securities Identification Number (ISIN) of the instrument.

marketIdentifierCode.description: The code identifying the market where the instrument is traded.

asOf.description: Timestamp indicating when the data is applicable.

dataSource.description: Source from which the market data was obtained.

recordStatus.description: The current status of the record (e.g., active, inactive).

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update made to the record.

GetFinancialMarketResearchByIdResponse_2.description: Response schema for financial market research operations.

correlationId.description: Identifier used to trace a specific request-response pair.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region where processing of the request occurred.

Metadata.description: Metadata associated with the financial market research response.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: A unique identifier representing the specific endpoint that was called, intended for tracking and logging purposes.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the application that processed the request, helpful for identifying the source of the response.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme utilizes Bearer authentication, allowing clients to authenticate via a JSON Web Token (JWT). The token must be provided in the `Authorization` header as a Bearer token.
